audit.whatIsWrong: Stormbringer was described as giving 'a big health shield' in spikes[1], mid, phases[4].why and wants.foe[2].
audit.why: Riot's text: Stormbringer grants BONUS HEALTH, not a shield, and its signature effect — disabling enemy towers near his landing point — was never stated anywhere. The shield in his kit belongs to Sky Splitter (E). Its cooldown is 160/135/110, an enormous window the page never used.
audit.corrected: Bonus health and the tower disable written in, with the 160s rank-1 cooldown as the thing to play around.

audit.whatIsWrong: The entire full layer names his E as 'Hand of the God' and calls it a point-and-click stun — focus.text, loading, enemyWin, breakdown.cooldowns/mid/late/wave/trading, phases[4-5].why, dosFull[1], dontsFull[1], report[5], report[9] and report[10] all repeat it.
audit.why: Volibear has no ability called Hand of the God. His E is Sky Splitter, a 1200-range located lightning bolt that damages, slows and shields HIM if he stands in it — no stun at all. The stun is Thundering Smash (Q), 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s, which also carries an auto-attack reset. Every piece of advice keyed to 'bait the E stun' was pointing you at the wrong cooldown, so a player would bait Sky Splitter and then get stunned by the Q.
audit.corrected: Every occurrence re-keyed to Thundering Smash (Q) with its 12s rank-1 cooldown; Sky Splitter named where the slow and his shield actually come from. report[5] also corrected — his W has no slow, and Meditate is a channel his Q stun cancels.

audit.whatIsWrong: No mention of Grievous Wounds anywhere despite the whole lane being framed around out-damaging his healing.
audit.why: Frenzied Maul is a 5s-cooldown recast that heals him, and every 'you out-DPS his heal' claim on the page depends on that heal being shredded first.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal written into breakdown.trading and spikes[3].text.

edits.after: Thundering Smash (Q) — the 12s dash-stun that lands the moment your Alpha Strike ends and you're grounded, setting up his Frenzied Maul bites. Never commit Alpha Strike while his Q is available.

edits.before: Volibear lands the E (Hand of the God) stun the instant your Alpha Strike lands and you're stuck on the ground, then stacks W bites that heal off your missing HP and Q-dashes to chase, killing you before your on-hit ramps; if he gets one early lead his max-HP healing snowballs out of your reach.
edits.after: Volibear lands Thundering Smash (Q) the instant your Alpha Strike ends and you're stuck on the ground, then stacks Frenzied Maul bites that heal off your missing HP while Sky Splitter (E) slows you and shields him, killing you before your on-hit ramps; one early lead and his healing snowballs out of reach.

edits.before: Track his E (Hand of the God) — it's the long-cooldown point-and-click stun that catches you the instant Alpha Strike lands and you're grounded. If E is down, your on-hit DPS wins; if it's up, never commit a Q until you've baited it.
edits.after: Track Thundering Smash (Q) — 12s at rank 1, the dash-stun that catches you the instant Alpha Strike ends and you are grounded. With his Q down your on-hit DPS wins the brawl; with it up, never commit Alpha Strike until you have baited it.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 your Wuju Style true damage and Meditate channel-heal come online and the lane stabilizes into short trades. Level 6 is the pivotal beat: his E (Hand of the God) stun plus Q dash makes him a real gank-dive threat, but Highlander gives you move/attack speed and slow immunity to dodge or punish that exact play. Neither champ runs the other off the lane here — it's a skill stage about who respects the E.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 your Wuju Style true damage and Meditate channel-heal come online and the lane stabilizes into short trades. Level 6 is the pivotal beat: Thundering Smash (Q) into Stormbringer (R), which disables your tower where he lands, makes him a real dive threat, but Highlander's move/attack speed and slow immunity punish that exact play. Neither champ runs the other off lane here — it is about who respects the Q.

edits.before: At 2+ items Master Yi flips to favoured. Kraken Slayer/BORK/Wit's End on-hit shreds even a stacked-health Volibear faster than W can heal, Alpha Strike's untargetable frames eat his E stun and reset on champ hits, and a single kill refreshes Highlander to chain through the next fight. Wit's End's MR and on-hit also answer his bruiser-tank brawl directly.
edits.after: At 2+ items Master Yi flips to favoured. Kraken Slayer/BORK/Wit's End on-hit shreds even a stacked-health Volibear faster than W can heal, Alpha Strike's untargetable frames eat his Q stun and reset on champ hits, and a single kill refreshes Highlander to chain through the next fight. Wit's End's MR and on-hit also answer his bruiser-tank brawl directly.

edits.before: Best wave: a slow-push you can freeze just outside his tower once you out-scale, denying his W sustain free farm and setting a Q-reset all-in. Worst wave: a fast-shoving wave pre-6 that pins you under tower where his Q-dash + E stun + jungler collapse with no escape but Q. Crash timing: crash into his tower right before your first on-hit item back so you reset on-item and deny him the bounce.
edits.after: Best wave: a slow-push you can freeze just outside his tower once you out-scale, denying his W sustain free farm and setting a Q-reset all-in. Worst wave: a fast-shoving wave pre-6 that pins you under tower where his Thundering Smash and jungler collapse with no escape but Q. Crash timing: crash into his tower right before your first on-hit item back so you reset on-item and deny him the bounce.

edits.before: Pre-6 you lose the auto-trade to W's bite-heal, so only trade with a Wuju-empowered burst when his W is on cooldown. Post-item you reverse it: Q in untargetable to dodge E, E on for true damage, and grind the on-hit DPS he can't kite or heal through.
edits.after: Pre-6 you lose the auto-trade to W's bite-heal, so only trade with a Wuju-empowered burst while his W is down. Post-item you reverse it: Alpha Strike in untargetable through his Q stun, Wuju Style on, Grievous Wounds applied so Frenzied Maul stops paying for itself, then grind the on-hit DPS.

edits.before: It rates 5/10 because the lane is genuinely even (51.67% WR): you're badly behind for six levels and must respect the E stun, but your scaling is so steep that surviving to two items flips it — the difficulty is patience and dodging one ability, not a fundamentally losing matchup.
edits.after: It rates 5/10 because the lane is genuinely even (50.5% WR): you're badly behind for six levels and must respect his Q stun, but your scaling is so steep that surviving to two items flips it — the difficulty is patience and dodging one ability, not a fundamentally losing matchup.

edits.before: Your Highlander R answers his level-6 E-stun gank-and-dive with slow immunity, but his R tower-disable + shield matches it — neither owns the fight.
edits.after: Your Highlander answers his level-6 Q-stun dive with slow immunity, but Stormbringer disables your tower and hands him bonus health — neither owns the fight.

edits.before: Kraken/BORK on-hit plus Q going untargetable through his E stun means you out-DPS the tank in an extended brawl.
edits.after: Kraken/BORK on-hit plus Q going untargetable through his Q stun means you out-DPS the tank in an extended brawl.

edits.after: Before any all-in, force or wait out Thundering Smash (Q); with his stun on cooldown, Alpha Strike in untargetable and your on-hit DPS out-trades the tank.

edits.after: Don't Q into a live Q stun

edits.before: If you blow Alpha Strike while his Hand of the God is available, you land grounded into a guaranteed stun, W bites, and a Q-dash chase that kills you.
edits.after: If you blow Alpha Strike while Thundering Smash is available, you land grounded into a guaranteed stun, stacked Frenzied Maul bites, and a chase that kills you.

edits.before: Alpha Strike's untargetable frames dodge his E (Hand of the God) stun and W bite if timed on his cast; Highlander's slow immunity ignores his W slow; Wit's End's MR and on-hit answer his bruiser-tank brawl; Meditate out-sustains a single W bite but not his stacked double-bite early.
edits.after: Alpha Strike's untargetable frames dodge Thundering Smash (Q) and Sky Splitter (E) if timed on the cast; Highlander's slow immunity ignores the Sky Splitter and Stormbringer slows; Wit's End's MR answers his bruiser damage; Meditate is a channel his Q stun cancels outright, so never start it in his range.

edits.before: Only all-in pre-6 if his W is down and you've already chunked him; the real window opens at first on-hit item with his E (Hand of the God) on cooldown and Highlander up to chase and reset.
edits.after: Only all-in pre-6 if his W is down and you've already chunked him; the real window opens at first on-hit item with Thundering Smash (Q) on cooldown and Highlander up to chase and reset.

edits.before: This lane is gank-decided — his E stun is a perfect setup for a jungler, and you have only Q to escape, so ward early and respect ganks while weak; once you have Highlander, your slow immunity and Q let you survive collapses he'd otherwise convert into a fed dive.
edits.after: This lane is gank-decided — his Q stun is a perfect setup for a jungler, and you have only Q to escape, so ward early and respect ganks while weak; once you have Highlander, your slow immunity and Q let you survive collapses he'd otherwise convert into a fed dive.

edits.before: EVEN (51.67%): a six-level survival check that flips hard the moment Master Yi itemizes — dodge the E, out-scale the bite, and the tank becomes your favorite snack.
edits.after: EVEN (50.5%): a six-level survival check that flips hard the moment Master Yi itemizes — dodge the Q stun, out-scale the bite, and the tank becomes your favorite snack.

edits.before: Stormbringer (R) leaps onto you, slows and zones you with the lightning field, and gives him a big health shield — turning any fight into his favor. At 6 he can all-in and you can't burst through the shield, so respect his R range and don't get caught in the field.
edits.after: Stormbringer (R) leaps 550 units onto you, slows you, hands him bonus health, and disables your tower where he lands — so the turret is no refuge at 6. It is a 160s cooldown at rank 1, though: survive it or bait it, and the next stretch of lane is yours.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 read even as you both scale, then his level 6 Stormbringer keeps the pressure on — the leap, slow field, and health shield let him all-in you before your items come online, and you can't burst through the shield. Play safe around his R cooldown, hold Alpha Strike to dodge his Q engage, and cross-map to jungle skirmishes where you scale.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 read even as you both scale, then his level 6 Stormbringer keeps the pressure on — the leap, the slow, and the bonus health let him all-in before your items land, and it disables your tower where he drops. Play around its 160s cooldown, hold Alpha Strike to dodge his Q stun, and cross-map to jungle skirmishes where you scale.

edits.before: Late your true-damage on-hits plus Highlander (R) attack speed melt Voli faster than he can heal or shield, and kill resets let you snowball fights. He still bursts you with R engage, so open with Alpha Strike to dodge his Q and only commit when your ult is up.
edits.after: Late your true-damage on-hits plus Highlander (R) attack speed melt Voli faster than Frenzied Maul heals, and kill resets snowball fights — carry Grievous Wounds so that heal never catches up. He still engages with R, so open with Alpha Strike to dodge his Q stun and commit with your ult up.

edits.before: Level 6 Stormbringer's shield and zone let him all-in before you spike.
edits.after: Level 6 Stormbringer disables your tower and lets him dive you freely.

edits.before: Stormbringer (R) leap, shield, and zone to all-in
edits.after: Stormbringer (R) leap, bonus health, tower disable

notes: MAJOR: the entire full layer called Volibear's E 'Hand of the God' and treated it as a point-and-click stun. No such ability exists — E is Sky Splitter (located bolt, damage/slow, shields HIM), and the stun is Thundering Smash (Q, 12s at rank 1). Every 'bait the E' instruction on the page sent the player to bait the wrong spell and then eat the stun. Fixed in 13 full-layer fields. Stormbringer's 'health shield' was also wrong (bonus health) and its tower disable was never mentioned. Win rate stated as 51.67% in two places, actually 50.5%.
